Name: Seasonal Haystacks with Tools (TMX)
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
Hey, do you want to have decorative buildable haystacks that changes with seasons? If yes, so there they are.
I just wanted to have haystacks that don't replace silo, nothing more. So I decided to share my work on the nexus.
You can choose between two: one is coming with water trough, one without. Or you can install both of them in the same time!

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL Map Toolkit (TMX Loader)[/url] which in turn requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]. Please see the instructions for opening the buildables menu on the TMXL Map Toolkit page.
by default hotkey for building menu - F2

[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PytK[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL Map Toolkit[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
Enjoy!
